item.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in team-alembic ash authentication allows a user with an account to install a TOTP secret they control on another user's account, and then sign in as that user or hold their second factor. AshAuthentication.Strategy.Totp.ConfirmSetupChange verified a setup token but did not check that it was issued to the record being confirmed, so an attacker's own…

JSV.Helpers.RegexExt.bounded match?/2 runs schema regexes with a backtracking budget but calls :re.run/3 without :report errors, so a match that…

item.title: Unbounded request body accumulation causes memory exhaustion in elixir-grpc/grpc
item.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust the BEAM's memory and crash the server by streaming a large or slow-trickle unary request body. 'Elixir.GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.Handler':read full body/3 (lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy/handler.ex) accumulates every received chunk into a single growing binary with no size cap.…

item.title: Cloudflare Access Issue
item.description: Cloudflare is investigating an issue with Cloudflare Access. A recent Cloudflare Access release removed the sub claim from service token JWTs, which can cause authentication failures for applications that strictly validate token claims. The change has been reverted and the fix is rolling out globally.

item.title: ASRock｜ASRock Polychrome SYNC/RGB software utility - Improper Access Control
item.description: ASRock Polychrome SYNC/RGB software utility developed by ASRock Inc. has an Improper Access Control vulnerability. Authenticated local attackers can send a specially crafted IOCTL request to cause the driver to write to improperly restricted I/O ports, resulting in a forced operating system reboot.

item.title: ASRock｜ASRock Polychrome SYNC/RGB software utility - Untrusted Pointer Dereference
item.description: ASRock Polychrome SYNC/RGB software utility developed by ASRock Inc. has an Untrusted Pointer Dereference vulnerability. Authenticated local attackers can send a specially crafted IOCTL request to cause the driver to dereference an unvalidated pointer, resulting in an operating system crash.

item.title: CVE-2026-132825
item.description: Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. One byte can be written outside a buffer for, for example, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252.

item.title: Feast: feast: unsafe dill deserialization of registry-stored udfs — rce on feature server and registry server
item.description: A flaw was found in Feast. The system improperly deserializes user-defined functions (UDFs) stored in its registry, which are serialized using the 'dill' library. This allows a remote attacker to store a malicious UDF, leading to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution on the feature server in default configurations. An authenticated attacker can also achieve arbitrary code execution on the registry server by…

item.title: Comelit 1456B Multi-User Gateway exposes all role passwords in cleartext via Installer-accessible backup
item.description: The Comelit 1456B Multi-User Gateway, in firmware versions up to and including 2.10.0, allows a user authenticated to the web interface with the Installer role to export a system configuration backup. item.title: Comelit 1456B Multi-User Gateway ships with default administrative credentials

The attacker can then use the GET /api/v1/files/{file id}…
